purpose: Close the bounded Stage 0 PNG low-bit, 16-bit sample, and greyscale-alpha sidecar decoder gap without claiming APNG, live editor, package runtime, or full PNG conformance.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG color type and bit depth matrix, packed scanline sizing, filter method 0, PLTE, IDAT, and CRC semantics.

variant_specs.description: PNG color type 0, 1-bit packed greyscale samples.
PNG color type 0, 2-bit packed greyscale samples.
PNG color type 0, 4-bit packed greyscale samples.
PNG color type 3, 1-bit packed palette indices with PLTE.
PNG color type 3, 2-bit packed palette indices with PLTE.
PNG color type 3, 4-bit packed palette indices with PLTE.
PNG color type 2, 16-bit RGB truecolor samples.
PNG color type 4, 8-bit greyscale plus alpha samples.
PNG color type 4, 16-bit greyscale plus alpha samples.
PNG color type 6, 16-bit RGBA truecolor with alpha samples.

limitations: Stage 0 deep-color decoder supports bounded non-interlaced PNG only.
Supported color types are greyscale, truecolor, indexed color, greyscale-alpha, and truecolor-alpha.
Low-bit and greyscale carriers can be visually quantized; semantic metadata is restored from the Mechagotchi sidecar.
APNG, full PNG conformance, live editor rewrite behavior, and final production carrier selection are not claimed.
